sections.heading: Exposure validation and application security assurance
sections.body:
Use two distinct assessment lanes: authorised external assets for exposure validation, and scoped repositories and dependencies for code and supply-chain analysis. VajraX and VectorX support those lanes; specialist testing turns findings into prioritised remediation and retest evidence.

This service covers web applications, APIs, repositories and software supply chains. [AI security & GRC](/services/cyber-security/ai-security-grc) covers AI and LLM risk testing and controls. Connect security findings with [Quality engineering](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) when release quality and security gates need one assurance scope.

sections.heading: Products and specialist services, clearly separated
sections.description: Agree assets, repositories, test limits and supported checks before work. Product access does not automatically include specialist assessment or remediation.

sections.heading: Choose an assessment or product walkthrough
sections.description: Before your next release, discuss an assessment, product walkthrough or ongoing validation. Do not include credentials, source code or vulnerability details in an enquiry.

items.title: How does product access differ from services?
items.description: VajraX and VectorX are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without Linkfields services. A specialist engagement separately agrees testing, validation, remediation and retest responsibilities; software access alone does not establish verified closure.

items.title: Which repositories and integrations are supported?
items.description: Confirm languages, repositories, dependency checks, CI/CD and ticketing integrations in the product walkthrough and assessment scope. The two-lane workflow describes an engagement pattern, not automatic interoperability between products.

items.title: What evidence supports a release decision?
items.description: The authorised scope and test date, finding and validation status, severity method, owner decisions, approved remediation, retest outcome and residual exceptions. Agree quality and security acceptance with engineering and risk owners.

items.title: How do we engage securely?
items.description: Fixed Price suits a defined assessment; Time & Materials suits evolving discovery. Ongoing validation can use an agreed Managed Service scope; Outcome-Based commercials require measurable, evidenced acceptance. We can agree an NDA and secure exchange before confidential review; read our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy) before enquiring.
